answer: Here is one concrete wall: Signed choir rehearsal attendance record. It works because rehearsals attended weekly for three years, and the willow it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own rehearsals attended weekly for three years, and the opal grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the marble for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
